plan.coverage_explanation: Tests TEMP and HUMI independently with changing sensor values, repeated commands, return transitions, and both newline and idle-delimited command framing. BOTH alternation timing, initial display mode, initial serial-output enable state, serial report content, and report frequency are unspecified. Consequently, timed BOTH alternation and button-controlled serial-output toggling are not independently asserted by this suite.
assumptions: Uses the authoritative wiring: TM1637 CLK D4 and DIO D5, button D2, and DHT11 data D7.
Relies on the disclosed bench default for the button: D2 connects to GND when pressed and uses INPUT_PULLUP.
Temperature is displayed in degrees Celsius and humidity in percent; integer sensor values avoid unspecified rounding behavior.

No initial display mode, serial-output enable state, BOTH alternation period, serial report period, or serial report format is specified. The reference selects permitted defaults, but checks do not require those choices.
Display checks allow leading blanks or zeros and provide several seconds for DHT cache refresh and command processing.
